Jordan (oncall): Morning all — quick async standup:

- did: rotated canary to v2 runtime, pushed KV warmup fix, rebalanced pods on gpu-pool-3
- blockers: sporadic flapping on `slo:request_latency_95` causing alert flood (~2k alerts in last 3h)
- today: triage alert noise, try short debounce, handoff at 09:30 PST

Priya: Thanks — can you paste the PromQL you used for the alert? I'll check paging/aggregation rules. Also heads-up I'm OOO tomorrow afternoon :wave:

Jordan (oncall): PromQL here:
```
max_over_time(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference"}[5m])[5m:1m])
```
Also seeing most noise from canary instances with pod label `variant=canary`.

ops-bot: Canary suppression applied via rollout-policy (backoff=30s). Incident: https://redwood.incidents/INC-5234 :information_source:

Luca: If it's primarily canaries, try increasing debounce to 120s and add `severity:low` for canary alerts. Also run:`./scripts/kv-warmup --region=us-west2 --parallel=4`

Priya: Ack. I'll open a follow-up ticket (SRE-715) to track debounce rule + paging changes and assign to @Taylor for CR review. :+1:

Taylor: I have the debounce CR ready, will attach shortly. @Priya if you want I can stage the rule in staging for 1h canary before prod roll.

Jordan (oncall): Handoff to Priya done. I'll monitor next 45m. @ops-bot escalate to oncall if error_rate > 5% or alerts > 100/min. Thanks :thumbsup:
